types.name: Family apartment suburbs
types.blurb: Lower incomes, crowded housing and many children, much of it in apartment buildings.

types.name: Affluent house neighbourhoods
types.blurb: The highest incomes, home values and school results, and the least crime.

types.name: Settled suburban houses
types.blurb: Detached houses, long-time owners and more seniors; few renters or movers.

types.name: New condo districts
types.blurb: Recent towers, young adults and constant turnover; few children or seniors.

types.name: Older family streets
types.blurb: Pre-1960 houses, large street trees and children; few condos or recent immigrants.

types.name: Older working suburbs
types.blurb: Older houses beside industry: little tree cover, hot ground, fewer degrees, more violent crime.

types.name: Fast-building apartment areas
types.blurb: The most construction and proposals; renters, movers and lower home prices.

types.name: Inner-city neighbourhoods
types.blurb: Dense older streets near downtown: short-term rentals, few children, few detached houses.

typing.method: Ward's hierarchical clustering on percentile ranks, themes weighted equally, Voting left out
